title: Great but I’m done
body:
The app is really great! But….I didn’t want to use premium version, I just don’t need it. In my opinion, the app forces you to buy the premium. First of all, you have only 3habits (okay, this one I can understand) and second thing is that you can ticking off your habits only 15 times per week. So, okay if I have 3 habits for every day I have to click it 21 times per week, but I can do this only 15 times without premium. It’s not fair.
App should be so good that people want to buy premium, not so defective in a basic version that people must to pay for it. I’m just really disappointed, cause I like this app, but now I have to find another one.

title: It's good with big BUT
body: I've been using this app for years, and in principle, it does what it says it does. What's really frustrating, though, is that the UI and features in the stats section change entirely every few months. I'm really tired of figuring out how to use the new features in my habit-tracking routine and then being forced to do it all over again but with different data and UI and features. Dear developer, if you add new features, please leave the old ones intact. Or be more considerate when adding the new ones. Bottom line: right now, your app makes it impossible to form any long-term habits when it comes to tracking my habits!

title: Najlepsza i najbardziej elastyczna apka do trenowania nawyków

Mnie ujęła przede wszystkim prostota połączona z elastycznością ustawień częstotliwości nawyku (wybór typu dni np. robocze + samodzielne zaznaczanie dni + ilość razy w tygodniu etc.) Do tego opcja przypominania co pół godziny o pominiętym nawyku jest bardzo przydatna. Wsparłem developera zakupem pełnej wersji i jestem bardzo zadowolony - polecam z czystym sumieniem!
